events.name: Bash
events.head: Check existing probe evidence, probe scripts, task log state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls -la workshop-plan/evidence/T-100* 2>&1; head -c 2500 workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-09.txt; echo; ls app/scripts | grep -iE 'shoot-vip|probe-page|probe-layout|widths' ; git log --oneline -5 -- app/src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx app/src/app/vip | cat; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe script options and check local servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -nE "process\.env\.[A-Z_]+" scripts/shoot-vip.mjs scripts/probe-page.mjs | head -30; sed -n 1,25p scripts/shoot-vip.mjs; git log --oneline f221b82..HEAD -- src public | wc -l; ls -d out ../live/site/vip 2>&1 | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'node|Python' | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local servers, export script location, live mirror checkout
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for p in 4322 4399 3000; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 3 -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:$p/vip; done; ls; ls app | head -40; find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'export-static.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*'; grep -n '"dev"\|"build"\|"start"' app/package.json; git -C live log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | cat; git -C live status --short 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start live mirror probes in background and read the export script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; B=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site; (for w in 390 414 768 1024 1280 1440 1920; do echo "## $w"; BASE=$B PREFIX=/vip/ WIDTH=$w node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | tail -14; done; echo "## probe-page"; BASE=$B PATH_=/vip/ node scripts/probe-page.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v '^$' | tail -14) > /tmp/t100-live.txt 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for running Next processes and build dirs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; pgrep -fl "next (dev|build|start)|export-static" | head; ls -d .next .next-* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "distDir" next.config.ts

events.text: Live mirror probes are running in the background; now starting a local server for main so I can run the same 7-width probes there.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start a dev server for main on a spare port and check live probe progress
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-t100 nohup npx next dev -p 4388 > /tmp/t100-dev.log 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start main probes in background and read the rest of the shoot script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; B=http://localhost:4388; (for w in 390 414 768 1024 1280 1440 1920; do echo "## $w"; BASE=$B PREFIX=/vip WIDTH=$w node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | tail -14; done; echo "## probe-page"; BASE=$B PATH_=/vip node scripts/probe-page.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v '^$' | tail -14) > /tmp/t100-main.txt 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how count chips are built in the stack component; check probe progress
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -nE "count|STACK\b|TEMPLATES|SESSIONS|STAGES|VIP only|data-" src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx | head -70; echo; cat /tmp/t100-live.txt | tail -20; echo ---; tail -5 /tmp/t100-main.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the stack data and how counts are derived
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -nE "STACK|count|stat|TEMPLATES|SESSIONS|STAGES|filter|length" src/lib/vip-kit.ts* | head -50; sed -n 84,110p src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx; grep -nE "^export (const|function) " src/lib/template-library.ts | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read count derivations in vip-kit
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 16,46p src/lib/vip-kit.ts*; grep -nE "id: \"|metric:" src/lib/vip-kit.ts* | sed -n 1,30p | cut -c1-170

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find count filter definitions and template kinds
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -rnE "(AUTOMATION_SPECS|PAGE_SPECS|COPY_ASSETS) *=" src | cut -c1-260; grep -nE "^export type TemplateKind" -A 22 src/lib/template-library.ts | cut -c1-120 | head -30; tail -3 /tmp/t100-live.txt; tail -3 /tmp/t100-main.txt
